_about: Thomas Newberry (1811-1901), The Englishman's Bible, combining the English-Hebrew Bible and the English-Greek Testament (the Authorized Version marked for the Hebrew and Greek). Undated Hodder and Stoughton issue printed at Oxford by Horace Hart (Printer to the University 1883-1915); the Digital Library of India record dates it 1930. Added 2026-11-03 by lane A from Adam's Libronix inventory; Internet Archive OCR, raw; title and imprint read from the scan's title page. No uids minted. Newberry died 1901 and the printing is pre-1931, so US public domain. Its marking signs are typographic and will not survive OCR well.
